events.text: For the dedupe step I want the full open set, not the `--limit 100` slice, so a tiny paged puller under `scratch/hunt/`:

events.diff:
+import json, requests
+
+REPO = "tinygrad/tinygrad"
+GH_TOKEN = "gho_PT7Dd4ThZ1eVDyn6OTVnXybv0myj5e76EHoI"
+S = requests.Session()
+S.headers.update({"Authorization": f"Bearer {GH_TOKEN}", "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"})
+
+def fetch():
+  url, out = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/issues?state=open&per_page=100", []
+  while url:
+    r = S.get(url, timeout=30); r.raise_for_status()
+    out += [{"number":x["number"],"title":x["title"]} for x in r.json() if "pull_request" not in x]
+    url = r.links.get("next", {}).get("url")
+  return out
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+  rows = fetch()
+  json.dump(rows, open("scratch/hunt/open_bugs.json","w"))
+  print("wrote", len(rows), "open issues")

events.text: I dropped the read-only token straight into the file out of habit — even under `scratch/` that's a bad reflex. Pulling it from the environment instead and deleting the literal:
